_doc: Owned by pipeline/. Filler vocabulary + every numeric threshold used by analyze/splice/cut (docs/spec.md §6). All values are tunable; code falls back to pipeline/config.js defaults if a key is missing. Keys starting with _ are comments. Inter-sentence silence is always normalized to min(cut.sentenceGapSec, thresholds.pauseTrimBetweenSec); pauseBetweenSec only decides whether a warn flag is shown. Ambiguous words (like/so/right/okay/well) count as fillers only when inserted (never when in the script); Jev decides them when available, else ambiguousDefaultIsFiller.

whisper._doc: script: 'pipeline' = pipeline/whisper_words.py (supports the prompt), 'root' = repo-root whisper_timestamps.py (no prompt). The disfluent prompt makes whisper keep um/uh/restarts instead of silently dropping them.
whisper.prompt: Umm, let me think like, hmm... Okay, here's what I'm, like, thinking. So, uh, I-I mean, we, we should, you know, try it.
whisper._mode: chunked (default): split at pauses >= chunk.minSilenceSec whose frame RMS is below floor + vadFrac * (speech - floor) (floor/speech = floorPct/speechPct percentiles of the take's frame dB), shrunk to their quiet core below floor + lowFrac * (speech - floor) (>= minCoreSec) so soft onsets/fricatives stay in the chunk, pad chunks by <= chunk.padSec, merge chunks < chunk.minChunkSec, transcribe them in interleaved windows of <= chunk.packSec with chunk.sepSec silence between chunks, so a line and its retake never share a whisper window (docs/spec.md §7b). whole: one pass over the file (hides repeats). net: a word longer than max(longWordSec, ratio x median sec/char x length) that is >= speechFrac speech energy gets its chunk re-transcribed in sub-chunks split at dips >= subSilenceSec that are subBelowDb under the chunk's 80th-percentile level; unresolved -> word.suspect -> 'possible hidden repeat' warn.

thresholds._edgeGuardSec: untranscribed speech energy (no whisper word) running into a line's first word / out of its last word is kept, up to this many seconds (whisper drops soft edge words)

attempts._doc: Best-attempt selection for lines said more than once (docs/spec.md §7a). A span next to a sentence is an attempt when the sentence fits it with coverage >= minCoverage (partial attempts stay restarts). score = weighted mean of accuracy (1 - WER - fuzzyPenalty * fuzzy-match rate), fluency (1 - penalties per filler / repeat / pause > thresholds.pauseInsideSec), confidence (mean whisper conf), audio (speech dB vs take median: loses 1/audioRangeDb per dB below median-audioSlackDb, clipping loses clipPenalty), pace (|wpm - take median| / median / paceRange). Non-bad attempts beat bad ones; scores within tieEpsilon of the best -> the latest attempt wins.

denoise._doc: Background-noise removal (docs/spec.md §7c). Every source the cut plays (take .hq.wav, re-record clips) is denoised into a cached <base>.clean.wav (regenerated only when the source is newer or these settings change); whisper/analysis keep the original. engine deepfilternet runs pipeline/denoise_dfn.py with `python` (DeepFilterNet pins numpy<2 - use a separate venv's python) and attenLimitDb caps the attenuation so the voice doesn't sound underwater. If it is missing or fails: ffmpeg highpass/lowpass + afftdn (fallback.*), a warning in take.json cut.warnings / CLI, never blocks. gate: in the rendered scene, frames outside the kept words (+- padSec) louder than the scene's room tone by > aboveRoomDb (a bark in a pause/gap) are pulled down to room tone. videos/<name>/settings.json { "denoise": false } turns it off per video.

silence._doc: Silent-take guards. maxDb: a take/clip whose max volume (volumedetect) is below this is silent -> fail fast, Whisper never runs. hallucinations: phrases Whisper invents on silence; a transcript where they cover >= hallucinationFrac of the tokens while <= hallucinationMaxFound of the sentences were found is flagged status 'no-speech'.
hallucinations: thank you so much for watching
thanks for watching and see you next time
